title: a* mission metadata
description: Run metadata written once at run start to mission.json.

schema_version.description: Schema version for this mission artifact

problem_class.description: Canonical problem class used to key dispositions and episodic retrieval

anticipated_action_intents.description: Action intents expected during the run and used for prior retrieval

goal.description: Plain language description of the optimisation goal

artifact.description: What is being mutated and where it lives

memory_mode.description: Long-term memory surface used for the run

memory_scope.description: Logical scope for memory isolation, such as a project or workspace identifier

project_memory_id.description: Project-scoped identifier used by connector-backed or project-pack memory

plays_enabled.description: Whether coordinated parameter plays are enabled

research_policy.description: Whether the run may use external research and under what disclosure constraints.

enabled.description: Whether any networked or remote research is allowed during the run.

mode.description: The highest-permitted research scope for this run.

artifact_sharing.description: Whether artifact contents may be sent to external services as part of research queries.

allowed_sources.description: Optional domain/source allowlist when mode is allowlisted_external.

started_at.description: Run start timestamp retained for backwards compatibility with existing mission artifacts
